name: Inmugai ~Onna Yuusha Makan Quest~
original_name: 淫夢街 ～女勇者魔姦クエスト～
source:
A group of beauties who traveled the continent for peace stopped at the hometown of the wizard, Dennis.

A party to go to the floor to get rid of the tiredness of the long trip in the hotel.

However, what I woke up the next morning and witnessed was a figure of the city that became unmanned with a strange atmosphere.

In order to find out the cause of the strangeness, the group splits hands and explores the city ....
translation:
一群为和平而游历大陆的美女们，停驻在了魔法师丹尼斯的家乡。

众人在旅馆举办了一场宴会，以消除长途旅行的疲劳。

然而，第二天早上醒来时，她们看到的是整座城市变得空无一人、气氛诡异的景象。

为了查明异变的原因，众人分头探索城市……
